title: Oathline demo-production benchmark
purpose: Retrospective technical baseline plus newly formalized candidate evaluation rubric; not an existing external quality certification.

mandatoryGates.requirement: Every claimed event has inspected evidence; simulation, archive and explanation are labeled; causal continuity and coverage limits are preserved.
No unapproved mainnet action, credential disclosure, historical mutation, paid service or external data transfer.
Actual final MP4 contains picture, audible narration and licensed music; captions are visible without a player setting and a separate SRT is delivered.
150 seconds within 0.04s, 4500 frames, 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264 yuv420p limited-range Rec.709, stereo 48kHz AAC; full decode succeeds.
Exact per-scene audio sample lengths; no out-of-bounds or overlapping cues; inspect sync in the final export, not only sidecar metadata.
Encoded integrated loudness between -17 and -15 LUFS; target true peak at or below -1 dBTP, maximum QA tolerance -0.8 dBTP; no missing or inaudible dialogue.
Asset provenance and license obligations documented; required public-description music attribution included.
Source, needed assets, commands, evidence map, timing, QA, export hash and clear entrypoint supplied; accepted baseline preserved.

scoring.status: Proposed review protocol; no baseline or candidate scores assigned by this file.

scale.5: Exceptional for the brief, supported by review evidence

scoring.formula: Sum(weight * score / 5) only when all categories are assessed and all mandatory gates pass.
scoring.unassessedRule: Use null with a reason; do not substitute zero, renormalize missing categories, or claim a complete total.

categories.review: Concrete hook, comprehensible boundary/enforcement/evidence arc, meaningful progression, useful closing; explain the product after one viewing.
Readable genuine evidence, explicit provenance/scope, recognizable order continuity, no dependence on tiny disclaimers to rescue misleading main claims.
Actual listening: pronunciation, natural phrasing, pauses, technical clarity and a complete unhurried ending.
Output-size inspection and motion playback: legibility, hierarchy, crop quality, purposeful cursor activity, stable fonts and restrained motion.
Actual listening: musical fit, dialogue intelligibility, ducking without pumping, smooth edits and satisfying ending; supported by meters.
Visible, readable, grammatical, accurate and synchronized in playback; safe placement without masking proof or doubling subtitles.
Consistent finish, no dead/accidental frames, reproducible candidate, usable handoff and transparent limitations.
